jingchai-ji.zh: 江边送别：十朋将赴京城，玉莲难舍难分。
jingchai-ji.en: River farewell: Shipeng leaves for the capital; Yulian can hardly let go.

jingchai-ji.zh: 叮嘱深情：玉莲诉说恩义，荆钗为聘记在心。
jingchai-ji.en: Parting counsel: Yulian speaks of devotion; the thorn hairpin seals their bond.

jingchai-ji.zh: 赴考之志：盼蟾宫折桂，又愁仕途风波。
jingchai-ji.en: Exam ambitions: hope for success, fear of the official world’s storms.

jingchai-ji.zh: 遥望青云：情系荆钗，未别先问归期。
jingchai-ji.en: Eyes on the clouds: love tied to the pin; asking when he will return.

jingchai-ji.zh: 双喜临门：才子佳人、金榜题名的喜庆场面。
jingchai-ji.en: Double joy: scholar and beauty, exam success celebrated.

jingchai-ji.zh: 回望贫贱：钱氏女与荆钗聘礼的前尘旧事。
jingchai-ji.en: Looking back on hard days: the Qian daughter and the thorn-pin betrothal.

baitu-ji.zh: 寒夜凄清：风月萧索，身世飘零的开场氛围。
baitu-ji.en: Cold night opening: bleak wind and moon, a life adrift.

baitu-ji.zh: 患难奔波：白兔记中的流离与求生。
baitu-ji.en: Hardship on the road: exile and survival in Baitu Ji.

baitu-ji.zh: 团聚与辨认：亲情线逐步收束。
baitu-ji.en: Recognition and reunion: family threads draw together.

liangzhu-shibaxiangsong.zh: 十八相送起程：梁山伯送祝英台上路，依依不舍。
liangzhu-shibaxiangsong.en: Eighteen-li farewell begins: Liang escorts Zhu; reluctance to part.

liangzhu-shibaxiangsong.zh: 一路托物：借景、借物暗示深情，不便直说。
liangzhu-shibaxiangsong.en: Coded affection on the road: scenery and objects stand in for what cannot be said aloud.

liangzhu-shibaxiangsong.zh: 惜别将尽：相送将近终点，情意更浓、归期未卜。
liangzhu-shibaxiangsong.en: Near the end of the send-off: feeling deepens; return still uncertain.

liangzhu-shibaxiangsong-full.zh: 十八相送起程：梁祝惜别，刚上路。
liangzhu-shibaxiangsong-full.en: Eighteen-li farewell begins: Liang and Zhu set out.

liangzhu-shibaxiangsong-full.zh: 托景言情：沿途景物暗藏心意。
liangzhu-shibaxiangsong-full.en: Feeling through landscape: roadside scenes carry coded affection.

liangzhu-shibaxiangsong-full.zh: 相送将尽：离别在即，余情未了。
liangzhu-shibaxiangsong-full.en: Send-off nearly done: parting near, feeling unfinished.

xianglin-sao-xinsuanhua.zh: 心酸开场：祥林嫂缓缓开口，身世苦难将倾诉。
xianglin-sao-xinsuanhua.en: Bitter opening: Xianglin Sao begins; suffering is about to be told.

xianglin-sao-xinsuanhua.zh: 诉苦中段：丧子、冷遇与命运不公层层叠加。
xianglin-sao-xinsuanhua.en: Mid account: loss, cold treatment, and unjust fate pile up.

xianglin-sao-xinsuanhua.zh: 悲愤收束：控诉与叹息交织，情绪更沉。
xianglin-sao-xinsuanhua.en: Grief closes in: accusation and sighing; the tone grows heavier.

liangzhu-xia.zh: 梁祝下卷：情事急转，悲剧气氛渐浓。
liangzhu-xia.en: Later Butterfly Lovers: the story turns; tragedy gathers.

liangzhu-xia.zh: 化蝶前夕：诀别与不舍层层叠加。
liangzhu-xia.en: Before metamorphosis: farewell and reluctance pile up.

liangzhu-xia.zh: 收束：传说收尾，余韵未尽。

mudanting-huanhunji.zh: 还魂起：丽娘情思萌动，梦境与花园交织。
mudanting-huanhunji.en: Return begins: Liniang’s longing; dream and garden intertwine.

mudanting-huanhunji.zh: 寻梦与伤逝：生死相隔，情未断。
mudanting-huanhunji.en: Dream-seeking and mourning: life and death apart; love unbroken.

mudanting-huanhunji.zh: 还魂团圆线：梦梅与丽娘终得相认。
mudanting-huanhunji.en: Return and reunion: Mengmei and Liniang find each other.

chen-sanliang.zh: 陈三两开场：沉冤未雪，性情刚烈。
chen-sanliang.en: Chen Sanliang opens: injustice unmet; fierce temperament.

chen-sanliang.zh: 辩诬中段：据理力争，声情俱烈。
chen-sanliang.en: Mid defense: arguing with heat and clarity.

chen-sanliang.zh: 收束：是非渐明，余怒未平。
chen-sanliang.en: Close: truth clears; anger not fully spent.

zanghua-yin.zh: 葬花起：落花流水，伤春自怜。
zanghua-yin.en: Burial begins: fallen blossoms; spring grief.

zanghua-yin.zh: 吟花中段：花与人同命，愁绪更深。
zanghua-yin.en: Mid lament: flower and self share one fate.

zanghua-yin.zh: 收束：葬花已尽，余悲未消。

chai-tou-feng.zh: 钗头凤：旧情重逢，满腹酸楚。
chai-tou-feng.en: Chai Tou Feng: old love meets again; bitterness fills the air.

chai-tou-feng.zh: 诀别之痛：错负与无奈交织。
chai-tou-feng.en: Parting pain: regret and helplessness intertwine.

limaohuan-taizi.zh: 狸猫换太子：宫廷阴谋与母子失散。
limaohuan-taizi.en: Civet-cat swap: court intrigue; mother and child parted.

limaohuan-taizi.zh: 辨认与奔波：真相一线，风险未除。
limaohuan-taizi.en: Recognition on the road: truth near; danger remains.

limaohuan-taizi.zh: 收束：冤案将雪，团圆可期。
